description: v0.4 candidate: whole, signed snapshots a conforming host MUST import or MUST refuse when a company moves to it (migration.ready, spec/v0.4/SPEC.md section 8). The base is one company with one business policy and the seven registered business-fact kinds: a product with two revisions (the second adds a packaging revision), an open inventory@2 ledger with two facts, a party, an acknowledged order, a forecast, an object@1 location, and a flow@1 book with one goods ledger and one fact that moves stock into that location. A conforming host MUST import it and reproduce its projections exactly. Each case is the base with exactly one host import rule broken and the affected commands re-signed with the published key; a conforming host MUST refuse every case with invalid_snapshot. These rules go beyond the profile reducers and fixtures: they are the checks a destination re-runs on import. The keys are published on purpose: never use them for anything real.
rule: Import replays every signed command and record; it refuses with invalid_snapshot any record a live host would have refused when it was recorded, and any carried projection that replay does not reproduce.

cases.name: fact-unpublished-pack
cases.why: an inventory@2 fact pins a pack conversion (600000 base units per case-6 v1) that no product revision published

cases.name: fact-pack-before-published
cases.why: an inventory@2 fact pins case-6 v2, recorded while the product head published only v1; the later product revision that adds v2 does not make it valid

cases.name: product-drops-packaging
cases.why: a product revision drops packaging revision case-6 v1

cases.name: product-alters-packaging
cases.why: a product revision changes packaging revision case-6 v1 in place (6 to 8 base units)

cases.name: order-born-acknowledged
cases.why: an order whose first record is already acknowledged

cases.name: order-lines-after-acknowledgment
cases.why: an acknowledged order revised with a changed line quantity

cases.name: forecast-subject-changed
cases.why: a forecast revision that changes its subject

cases.name: party-kind-changed
cases.why: a party revision that changes its kind from organization to unit

cases.name: person-party-business-policy
cases.why: a person party held under a business-classified policy

cases.name: ledger-projection-differs
cases.why: the carried inventory@2 ledger holds one more jar than replaying its signed facts produces; no signature is changed

cases.name: object-class-changed
cases.why: an object@1 revision that changes its class from dtp/location to dtp/vehicle

cases.name: flow-fact-unpublished-pack
cases.why: a flow@1 fact pins a pack conversion (600000 base units per case-6 v1) that no product revision published

cases.name: flow-book-differs
cases.why: the carried flow@1 book holds one more jar than replaying its signed openings and facts produces; no signature is changed
